description: This file defines the class AttributeExpressionImpl, which implements various interfaces related to query expression components for attributes, including acceptors for visitors, and overrides equals, hashCode, and toString methods. It is part of a query expression model in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AttributeExpressionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of attribute-related query expression interfaces allowing acceptor methods for visitors, equality checks, and string representation.

methods.name: acceptSortVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a sort visitor and applies it to the attribute key.

methods.name: acceptFilterVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a filter visitor and applies it to the attribute key.

methods.name: acceptExistsVisitor
methods.description: Accepts an exists visitor and applies it to the attribute key.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a generic field expression visitor.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the attribute key.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on class type and key value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
